_comment: Validated model coefficients for comparative + referee-aware markets. All values were tuned on the 2026-06-03 walk-forward backtest (held-out). NOT data — these are model hyperparameters (like kelly_fraction). Base rates are NOT here: they are computed live from match history. Edit + restart the dashboard to retune.

comparative_stats._comment: Per-stat confidence mode from validation. signal=show model %, shrunk=shrink toward live base rate by `shrink`, low_diff=show live base rate.

referee_total_markets._comment: lambda = ref_weight*ref_avg + (1-ref_weight)*(home_rate+away_rate). ref_weight + lines validated held-out.

market_trust._comment: Trust verdict per market from the 2026-06-03 harsh walk-forward backtest (2017+, FDR-corrected). 'trust' markets are recommended for best-bets; 'noise' are shown but never recommended. base_rate = the market's empirical home/over rate, used to compute confidence-above-base (lift). Edit when re-backtested.

ou_2.5.note: Poisson-only backtest negative, but production ensemble O/U is CLV+ profitable

best_bets._comment: Best-bets engine settings. min_lift = min confidence-above-base to recommend. combo_max_legs = max combo size. Only 'trust' (+ ensemble_only for O/U) markets are recommended.

odds_comparison._comment: Edge thresholds + Kelly caps. Mirror production betting_unified.py. min_edge per market from the calibration backtest (who-wins=low bar, goal-quantity=high bar).
